description: Finds images in the media library (all AI-generated) by what they show: the query is matched against a description of each image written by a vision model, its tags, title, colours and album, and the best matches come first. Returns permanent URLs, 100 per page, each with its description, dominant colours, brightness and where there is room for text, so you can pick the image that fits the layout. Use it for a motif ('red dress', 'laptop on a desk', 'misty forest') and narrow it with tone, text_space, use, color or people, e.g. query 'architecture' with text_space 'left' and tone 'dark' for a hero with white text on the left. Without a premium key only the free images are included.

color.description: A dominant colour by name, e.g. 'blue', 'sage', 'orange' (optional).

page.description: Page of the result, 100 images per page (optional, default 1).

query.description: One or more English words describing the motif. Images matching every word rank first; if none do, close matches follow. E.g. 'gradient', 'laptop desk', 'woman red dress'.

text_space.description: Where a calm area leaves room for a headline (optional). E.g. 'left' for a hero with the text on the left.

use.description: What the image is good for on a website (optional).

name: search_images
title: Search images
